target: ARM32 vendor HIDL service on verified Android12 API32 firmware
scope: Decoder-only 1.14.16 core on API32 with cached internal copy buffers, read-only DMA synchronization, standard work flow, original full-precision/HDR contracts and stop/drain ownership repair. Existing HIDL registry, secure and encoder routes remain firmware-backed.
mpp: Existing newer source-built MPP 1.1.0 compatibility pair retained; 2024 SDK MPP evaluated privately and not bundled.
kernel: Original 5.10.66 built-in Rockchip VPU driver, no kernel replacement or clock changes.
rollback: codec2_sdk_next off restores the separately packaged 1.14.3 SIMD core; codec2_sdk off restores the legacy backend.

local_av1_afbc_extension.scope: RK3588, native composer Surface, original eight/ten-bit precision, width divisible by 64; honors client FBC-disable

local_av1_afbc_extension.fallback: linear NV15; explicit P010, texture and CPU consumers retain existing paths

local_av1_texture_afbc_extension.fallback: Disable and reboot restores original P010 texture route; adaptive nonaligned/linear-layout info-change uses bounded full-precision copy
local_av1_texture_afbc_extension.validation: Bounded new-route precision, allocation, adaptive fallback and reboot rollback verified; original-player UHD pacing unresolved; experimental/default-off, not a public release

output_delay_notification.local_adaptation: Keep legacy inline-work/unknown-null-work behavior when disabled; initialize ordinal fields to zero; only cache null-work state when independent notification enabled

output_delay_notification.validation: Installed bounded four-codec zero-frame callback, null-work 6-to-16 update, async 3597-frame TextureView on/off, exact 8/10-bit AFBC, HDR and independent/whole-module reboot rollback verified; experimental/default-off, no FPS claim

hevc_native_surface.implementation: Local API32 info-change guard correction for verified RK3588 HEVC composer-only consumers; keep existing native NV15 output when ten-bit is discovered after setup. CPU, encoder, tunnel, explicit P010 and output-crop retain previous paths. FBC requests, pixels, bit depth, reference/output slots and fences unchanged.
hevc_native_surface.validation: Installed bounded late-profile native NV15/DEVICE, process CPU A/B, 194918400 exact samples including low bits, HDR and independent/whole-module reboot rollback verified; experimental/default-off, no universal FPS or latency claim

hevc_eos_pending.range: Only pending input ownership completion after true decoder EOS; HEVC-only qualification. Other process/init/stop changes excluded.
hevc_eos_pending.local_changes: Default-off constructor-latched property, batched completion outside queue/state locks, flushing guard, existing API32 core and module dependency/reboot rollback.
hevc_eos_pending.validation: Installed bounded input census: 8 to 0 pending at actual EOS, exact 60-frame/PTS output, reentrant queue callbacks, full ten-bit/HDR and independent/whole-module reboot rollback verified; default-off experimental, no generic FPS/seek claim

p010_pairs.origin: Local optimization of existing project MIT NV15 conversion, fixed upstream decoder base unchanged
p010_pairs.implementation: Gather adjacent source bytes into halfword lanes using two-register NEON table lookups; combine shift and masking without reducing ten-bit precision. Exactly twenty bytes per sixteen samples; row staging, mapper/fences, copies, output and reference slots unchanged. Constructor-latched reboot property.
p010_pairs.validation: Installed bounded TextureView Codec2 CPU-work reduction, exact full-ten-bit samples, native HDR and two-level reboot rollback verified. Explicit-P010 HDMI-HDR limitation reproduces identically ON/OFF and is not claimed fixed. Experimental/default-off; no universal FPS claim.

native_backpressure_candidate.scope: HEVC, non-tunneled native outputs; copy/P010 initialization/info-change retain prior fetching
native_backpressure_candidate.implementation: Local single-attempt prefetch via the existing platform pool; one delayed retry with flush/stop generation; actual completed-frame work only. No output-delay increase, watchdog change, fence bypass, or fake completions. V4L2 buffer-count constants are not transplanted.
native_backpressure_candidate.test1_result: Actual Exo pause/seek still reached MPP retry exhaustion and err0xe; rejected as fix.
native_backpressure_candidate.test2_input_flow_control: Only MPP_ERR_BUFFER_FULL plus an actual atomic native BQ C2_BLOCKING state waits for Surface recovery/flush without consuming the active delivery retry budget; other MPP errors fail and CCodec watchdog is unchanged.
